After the Wolf fired his nuke at the Tharkold maelstrom bridge, the backlash of nuclear fallout and technodemon waste rained down, changing not only the landscape of Northern Moscow and beyond, but the creatures, thralls, and Russian citizens there too. Those who survived adapted and gained power from the disaster.
